_source: Real webhook delivery captured live from icxeed.atlassian.net via CloudWatch Logs (attachment-sync-prod), 2026-08-14T09:09:24Z. This is the actual payload Jira sent for a real attachment_created event on JTT-102, not invented. Preserved here as the definitive answer to Phase 2's originally-skipped schema test, and as documentation for WHY this event was abandoned in favor of jira:issue_updated.
_finding: This payload has NO issue reference of any kind - no issue key, no issue id, nothing linking the attachment back to which ticket it belongs to. Cross-checked against the official GET /rest/api/3/attachment/{id} schema, which also lacks an issue/container field. This is a structural limitation of the attachment_created event, not a parsing problem.
